column1: # Weksa phone inventory, en-US (General American, broad). One phone per line, tab separated:
# class: consonant | vowel. tenseness: tense | lax | reduced for a vowel, `-` for a consonant. A multi-character
# phone (affricate, diphthong) is one entry and one phone. The segmenter reads only this file: an IPA symbol with no
# line here is refused, never guessed. Tense/lax is the textbook classification; it is what separates /i/ (nee) from
# /ɪ/ (nih). Stress is not a phone: ˈ and ˌ are read by the segmenter and put on the vowel that follows.
